“隆隆隆……”一架造价不菲的私人飞机盘旋而来，正飞翔在万米的高空之中，而螺旋桨的轰鸣声丝毫没有影响机舱内的三个美人。
飞机机舱内的电子信息设备十分完善，完全可以在飞机上处理任何日常事物，不会因为领导不在集团就耽搁了什么事情，这也是M百货短时间名震世界的秘诀！
这架私人飞机机舱内装饰奢华，纯白色的手工波斯长毛地毯，顶级水晶的吊灯偶尔有些晃动，楠木的家具安静柔和，其他的细节装饰略去不提，如果不是正飞在天上，会让人误以为是奢华的房车。
谁也不曾想到，名震世界、鼎鼎有名的M集团百货女王就在这架飞机上，只不过大多数人以为百货女王是一个人，其实是三个人，并且是三个隐世家族嫡系的继承人。
家族为了让后代出来历练，各自给些少量的财物，没想到这一辈还真的出来了佼佼者，短短三四年之间，成就了百货大王的商业传奇，这让闲着没事的一群长老们眼光贼亮，不止一次的催着她们回去打理家族的大业。
同时百货女王的事迹，也成为各大媒体盯着的头条，奈何百货女王行事低调，到目前为止，没有一家媒体见过真正的百货女王，只有媒体经常捕风捉影，说什么在某某地方见过了百货女王，博取可怜的点击。
这不是最近几天是频频打电话，发信息让她们回去，有几个长老还悄悄的跑到了公司去，不堪其扰的三千金只能躲到了天上，至少手机是不能开的，机上的电话看心情接或者不接。
其实她们三人谁也不想回去，谁愿意回去承担家族的重担，更没有人愿意为了别人当牛做马一辈子！
像她们现在这样多好，有大把的青春，每天做他们喜欢的事情，睡觉睡到自然醒，数钱能数到手抽筋，并且还能盈利，又养活她们自己多好！
她们想去哪里就去哪里，想做什么就做什么，多么的自由，回去事情就多了，利益牵扯之下，什么家族内的亲情、友情、爱情最终将不复存在！
尤其隐世家族已经传承几百年了，哪里就能真的隐世，只不过就是不愿意抛头露面，而那些产业改头换面罢了。
这样一来，她们三个牺牲了自我的一切时间，打理家族大业，同时还要被一些别有企图的人弄点不是你死就是我活的戏码，太没意思了。
现在正在开飞机的就是三个人的老大艾米，是个珠宝设计师，而且是有赌石验石的高手，对于艾米来说，这种能力似乎是与生俱来的，也掌管M百货下面的珠宝玉石，古玩字画业和奢侈品业。
艾米平时比较安静，也是三人中比较冷静睿智的类型，虽然长发飘飘，女人味十足，心里可是个十足的女汉子，平时冷面孔居多。
艾家是个大家族，利益争斗十分的厉害，艾米平时极少回去，她的父母是正经的嫡系，在她参加完家族的训练之后，她们一家就从家族老宅搬了出来。
这种毁天灭地的训练，恨不得能将后代的子嗣弄成超人的打法，是五个世家长老们一起研究的，就怕后背子孙不成器，如果不能通过这样选拔是不能列入继承者名单的。
当然该不成器的还是不成器，不能通过选拔的一大堆，因为这个训练包含了方方面面，功夫，智商，学业，各项特长等等，不过能坚持下来的都是佼佼者。
而艾米，司徒佳妮还有叶贝儿就是在年少五六岁时候相识，一直相伴到十多岁才完成了训练，她们三个也成了最好的朋友。
正在喝着极品的红酒，一袭波浪长发性感妖娆的司徒佳妮是老二，佳妮可是有名的服装设计师，还掌管百货业的服装布匹业，对于佳妮来说，对颜色的敏感是天生的。
尤其佳妮还有一手绝活，就是将古典和现代的纺织业结合，能生产出绝美的面料，这也是M百货业旗下的服装业能迅速窜起的原因之一。

佳妮的性子最为火爆，眼里容不得沙子，所以早早的带着父母出来，就是不愿看那个继奶奶的嘴脸。
司徒家是老世家了，不过佳妮的父亲是司徒家前夫人留下的长子，现任的司徒夫人是个继室，偏巧还是个喜爱权利的，想给自己的儿孙霸下整个司徒家的全部产业，偏偏她的那些儿孙没有一个成器的。

content_en:
"Rumble..." An expensive private jet hovered over and was flying at an altitude of 10,000 meters. The roar of the propeller did not affect the three beauties in the cabin at all.
The electronic information equipment in the aircraft cabin is very complete, and you can handle any daily matters on the aircraft. Nothing will be delayed just because the leader is not in the group. This is the secret of M Department Store becoming world-famous in a short time!
The cabin of this private jet is luxuriously decorated, with pure white handmade Persian shag carpets, top-quality crystal chandeliers that occasionally sway, and nanmu furniture that is quiet and soft. Other details are omitted. If it were not flying in the sky, people would mistake it for a luxurious RV.
No one would have thought that the world-famous M Group Department Store Queen would be on this plane. However, most people thought that the Department Store Queen was one person, but in fact there were three people, and they were the direct heirs of three hidden families.
In order to let the next generation come out to experience, the family gave each of them a small amount of property. Unexpectedly, this generation really emerged as a leader. In just three or four years, he became a business legend of the department store king. This made a group of idle elders very discerning and urged them to go back to take care of the family business more than once.
At the same time, the deeds of the department store queen have also become the headlines of the major media. However, the department store queen keeps a low profile. So far, no media has seen the real department store queen. Only the media often make false claims and say that they have seen the department store queen in a certain place to gain poor clicks.
This is not because they have been calling and sending messages frequently in the past few days to ask them to go back. Some elders even quietly ran to the company. Unable to be disturbed, San Qianjin could only hide in the sky. At least the mobile phone could not be turned on. The phone calls on the plane could be answered or not depending on the mood.
In fact, none of the three of them wants to go back, and no one is willing to go back and bear the burden of the family, and no one is willing to work as a cow and a horse for others all their lives!
How wonderful it is to be like them now, with a lot of youth, doing what they like every day, sleeping until they wake up naturally, counting money until their hands cramp, and being able to make a profit, how wonderful it is to support themselves!
They can go wherever they want and do whatever they want. With such freedom, there will be many things to do when they go back. With interests involved, the family ties, friendships, and love within the family will eventually cease to exist!
In particular, the reclusive family has been passed down for hundreds of years. Wherever they can really be reclusive, they just don't want to show their faces, and those industries have changed their appearance.
In this way, the three of them sacrificed all their time to take care of the family business, and at the same time, some people with ulterior motives had to make a drama of life or death. It was so boring.
The eldest of the three, Amy, is flying the plane now. She is a jewelry designer and a master of stone betting. For Amy, this ability seems to be innate. She is also in charge of the jewelry, jade, antiques, calligraphy and painting industry, and luxury goods under M Department Store.
Amy is usually quiet, and the calmer and wiser type among the three. Although she has long flowing hair and is full of femininity, she is a complete tomboy at heart and usually has a cold face.
The Ai family is a big family, and the struggle for interests is fierce. Amy rarely goes back. Her parents are direct descendants. After she participated in the family's training, her family moved out of the family's old home.
This kind of destructive training, hoping to turn the descendants into supermen, was studied by the elders of the five families. They were afraid that their descendants would be useless. If they could not pass this selection, they would not be included in the list of successors.
Of course, those who should be ineffective are still ineffective, and there are many who cannot pass the selection, because this training covers all aspects, including kung fu, IQ, academic studies, various specialties, etc., but those who can persist are the best.
And Amy,Situ Jiani and Ye Beier met when they were five or six years old and stayed together until they were more than ten years old before completing their training. The three of them also became best friends.
Situ Jiani, who is drinking the best red wine and has long wavy hair and is sexy and enchanting, is the second child. Jiani is a famous fashion designer and is also in charge of the clothing and fabric industry in the department store industry. For Jiani, her sensitivity to color is innate.
In particular, Jiani has a unique skill, which is to combine classical and modern textile industries to produce beautiful fabrics. This is one of the reasons why the clothing industry under M Department Store has been able to boom rapidly.
Jiani has the hottest temper and can't tolerate any sand in her eyes, so she brought her parents out early because she didn't want to look at the step-grandma's face.
The Situ family is an old family, but Jiani's father is the eldest son of the former wife of the Situ family. The current Mrs. Situ is a step-in-law, and she happens to be a power-loving person. She wants to give her children and grandchildren the entire Situ family's industry, but none of her children and grandchildren have succeeded.
